component.name: Alpha
component.summary: Chat with many LLM providers from one native Linux window

description.p: Alpha is a native GTK4 / libadwaita desktop chat client that talks to several large-language-model providers from a single window. Provider credentials are kept in your system keyring, and every conversation is yours on disk.

ul.li: OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, OpenRouter, AgentRouter, LocalAI, vLLM)
An offline demo provider that needs no network and no API key

description.p: Initial Alpha MVP: multi-provider chat, keyring-backed keys, offline demo mode.
